        AP2Action(106, AP2Action.GET_VARIABLE),
        IfAction(107, IfAction.IS_FALSE, 110),
        AP2Action(108, AP2Action.NEXT_FRAME),
        # Continue statement.
        JumpAction(109, 102),
        # Exit early.
